name: H2O America
outlook:
What H2O America says to expect

  • Full year 2026: standalone adjusted EPSThe company is narrowing standalone 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance to $3.10-$3.16, preserving the $3.13 midpoint of the original $3.08-$3.18 1 range.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted EPS with acquisitionsWith the close of the Quadvest acquisition on October 1, we are providing 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance of $2.91-$2.97, which incorporates the anticipated impacts of Quadvest and the pending Cibolo Valley acquisitions, including the financings thereof.
  • Full year 2026: annualized dividendThe 2026 annualized dividend is expected to be $1.76 per share compared with $1.68 per share in 2025.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 26, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
